LESSON: MANAGING WASTE ENVIRONMENT

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Caring for the 3.2 Caring for Animals By the end of the sub-strand,  In groups,
Topic 3.3: Managing waste environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Managing waste environment. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. participate in disposing of waste in the community
2. dispose waste responsibly to limit risks to self, others and the environment share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of. and disposal of waste in the community. 128 3.0 Care for the

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. participate in disposing of waste in the community
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to participate in disposing of waste in the community. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. dispose waste responsibly to limit risks to self, others and the environment share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of. and disposal of waste in the community. 128 3.0 Care for the
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to dispose waste responsibly to limit risks to self, others and the environment share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of. and disposal of waste in the community. 128 3.0 Care for the. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Managing waste environment.
2. Explain Managing waste environment to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should reflect, think and share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of.
4. Show that you can: participate in disposing of waste in the community
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Managing waste environment. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Managing waste environment important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Reflect, think and share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of.
2. Demonstrate sorting and disposal of waste in the community. 128 3.0 Care for the

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. dispose waste responsibly to limit risks to self, others and the environment share ideas about types of waste and how they could be sorted and disposed of. and disposal of waste in the community. 128 3.0 Care for the
